messages:
alex: FYI the deploybot blocked the release at 03:00 UTC — predeploy evals show a quality regression on summarizer v3.2.1 (delta +1.8 on extractiveness). deploybot: Deploy blocked by eval_gate: threshold_exceeded quality_delta=1.80, trigger=prompt-suite/summaries-2026. navin: Huh, which prompts are failing? quick glance or full bisect needed? alex: Two prompt groups failing: 'long-legal' and 'meeting-minutes'. quick samples below:
```
input: long legal doc (12k)
expected: concise neutral summary
model: v3.2.1 -> hallucinated clauses, lost obligations
```
maria: We have a couple options: 1) pin releases to v3.2.0 for the change window and ship the rest; 2) hotfix v3.2.1 (risky in-window); 3) deprioritize summarizer change and ship later. Thoughts? emily: I'm +1 for pinning for the window. We depend on summarizer in two internal routes and customer-facing nightly digests — better to avoid in-window hotfix churn. samir: If we pin, let's also open a quick bisect job against the prompt-suite to find the regression-causing commit; can do a fast gradient on quantization flags first. navin: Agree on pin but we should queue a manual canary with 5% traffic to verify no other regressions. deploybot: Action required: revert candidate: model-pin v3.2.0 for release 2026-06-10; to approve run `/deploybot approve-pin 2026-06-10 model:summarizer v3.2.0` alex: I've started the ticket and updated release notes draft: "Reverted summarizer model bump; will defer summarizer improvements to post-window v3.2.2. Customers on dedicated stacks unaffected." maria: Also add rollback plan snippet and contact list in notes (SLO owners + oncall). emily: Add a note to routing policy: prefer stable-summary variant for low-latency routes until hotfix validated. samir: I'll kick off the bisect run after pin is approved, ETA ~2.5 hrs. navin: Can we shift the change window by 2 hours to give bisect time? ops already said windows are tight today. alex: Ops declined shift; we need to make quick decision. maria: Decision: Pin for this window, schedule hotfix pipeline and bisect post-window, update release notes, notify customers via status page. add: @ops, please confirm the pin implementation and apply the model override across regions. deploybot: Pin applied in us-west-2 and eu-central-1, status: partial (awaiting ap-southeast-1). navin: Once ap-southeast-1 is done, please post final confirmation and I'll enable the 5% canary. alex: Noted. I'll send the customer-facing update and mark the release as 'partial-with-stable-summaries'. emily: Good. Leave the prompt-suite failing tests marked as blockers until bisect completes. maria: Thanks everyone. Samir — keep us posted when bisect identifies a candidate commit. samir: will do — posting results in this thread when available. :thumbsup:
